verdict.rationale: Sprinto's API reference includes a dedicated 'Custom Integration Push APIs' section with integration monitoring. Its ingestion docs describe webhooks that let external systems send data directly into Sprinto, plus ingestion workflows that can be built with an AI editor. Together these cover pushing data from systems the catalog doesn't cover, but the evidence is mostly page titles. Missing for 10: endpoint, auth and payload details showing evidence and test-result push semantics; a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404); independent or hands-on corroboration.
